items.title: West Michigan Officials Attend Closed Data Center Seminar Amid Protests in Dorr Township
items.dek: More than 100 municipal leaders from Allegan, Barry and Kent counties gathered for a private session on data center planning and zoning while dozens of residents protested outside over Microsoft’s proposed project.
items.judge_note: Concrete new event: closed seminar with 100+ officials in West Michigan counties with protest, distinct from earlier generic 'behind closed doors' story.
